title: @next/third-parties peerDependencies does not support Next 15 or React 19 RC

labels.name: bug
labels.description: Issue was opened via the bug report template.

body:
### Link to the code that reproduces this issue

https://codesandbox.io/p/devbox/elastic-platform-jl4fj3?workspaceId=63a0c815-1f7d-47eb-92e4-4472f4b22043

### To Reproduce

On the canary branch (https://github.com/vercel/next.js/blob/canary/packages/third-parties/package.json), we see:

```
"peerDependencies": {
  "next": "^13.0.0 || ^14.0.0",
  "react": "^18.2.0"
}
```

When using this package in a canary build using Next 15 and the appropriate React 19 RC, we get warnings in various package managers.

Reproduction steps:
* Have `"@next/third-parties": "15.0.0-canary.186",` in `packages.json`
* Run `yarn install`

For example, these are Yarn v4 warnings:

```
➤ YN0060: │ next is listed by your project with version 15.0.0-canary.186 (pb017a), which doesn't satisfy what @next/third-parties and other dependencies request (but 
they have non-overlapping ranges!).
➤ YN0060: │ react is listed by your project with version 19.0.0-rc-70fb1363-20241010 (p04274), which doesn't satisfy what @next/third-parties and other dependencies request (but the (but they have non-overlapping ranges!).
➤ YN0060: │ react is listed by your project with version 19.0.0-rc-70fb1363-20241010 (p04274), which doesn't satisfy what @next/third-parties and other dependencies request (but they have non-overlapping ranges!).
➤ YN0060: │ react is listed by your project with version 19.0.0-rc-70fb1363-20241010 (p04274), which doesn't satisfy what @next/third-parties and other dependencies requeste.       ➤ YN0060: │ react is listed by your project with version 19.0.0-rc-70fb1363-20241010 (p04274), which doesn't satisfy what @next/third-parties and other dependencies request (but they have non-overlapping ranges!).
➤ YN0060: │ react is listed by your project with version 19.0.0-rc-70fb1363-20241010 (p04274), which doesn't satisfy what @next/third-parties and other dependencies request (but they have non-overlapping ranges!).
```


### Current vs. Expected behavior

##Current
* Warnings in console during installation with package managers like yarn.

## Expected
* No warnings.

`@next/third-parties` should be supported on Next 15 / React 19 RC. I believe it doesn't use anything that is breaking.

### next usages:
* `next/script`

### react usages:
* `useEffect`
*
